template: Before I leave, take {a_cat}! And once you find my <style3>Old Postal Badge</style>, deliver it to <style1>Nim the Translator</style> in the Village!
Here, take {a_cat} as thanks for letting me out!
I've got {a_cat} for sale! Yours for <style2>100</style> fruits!
Tell you what, why don't you take {the_cat} and come back and pay me whenever you can, okay?
Please accept {a_cat} as your reward. You have earned it by showing you are sympathetic to our <style5>Rage</style5>.
May it serve you well on your travels.
...I left {a_cat} <style2>In My Shed</style>.
If you can get there, you're free to take it.
The lazy slob who used to live here left {a_cat} behind.
So the gig is pretty easy. I've left you {a_cat} with the Parrot.
And since you have completed all of the postal duties, {the_cat} in the attic is yours. Go ahead and claim it! Squawk!
Go ahead and claim {the_cat} in the attic!
Here, take {a_cat} for the journey. You'll need a key to get inside.
Here, take {a_cat}. And find our spores! We'll give you a reward once you've infected- we mean planted them above!
We hope {the_cat} serves you well!
Come back and visit us Fungoids sometime!
Take {a_cat} for your help! If you find our spores, plant them in the woods below. Somewhere <style1>Damp</style1> where we can gaze upon the impressive <style1>Statues</style1>.
Take {a_cat}! And if you find our spores, spread them someplace <style2>Dryer</style> next!
Take {a_cat}! We need some peace and quiet now: if you find our spores, a <style1>Frigid</style1>, lonesome spot, <style1>Far Above</style1> the bustle of the Island will do!
Okay, we've had it with cold, noise and dampness! Take {a_cat}, and if you find our spores, take them somewhere <style1>Hot, Dry and Quiet</style1>!
There you go, all sorted! Take {a_cat} for your trouble.
Please, let me show my appreciation for what you've done with {a_cat}!
So there was {a_cat} inside? Just as well that I didn't get it myself then.
...And I just happen to have {a_cat} that could bring someone good fortune.
Do you want to buy {the_cat} for <style1>300</style1> Fruit?
Here, take {a_cat}. You'll need the <style1>Key</style> to the gate of the Underbelly <style2>Below Our Hideout</style>. You can't miss it!
Fine, take {a_cat} - It's the last thing I've got on me, just get out of my hiding place, okay?
I just don't need it anymore. Here, take {a_cat} for your trouble instead!
I got {a_cat} here. 200 Fruits.
Here buddy, have {a_cat} for keeping it <style5>Natural</style5>!
I can tell that you respect the <style6>Sootlings</style>, so as thanks for your help I want you to have {a_cat}.
If you ever find a <style2>Sootling Leash</style2>, take it to the <style6>Sootling</style6> habitat in Frostpine Forest.
You'll find it in my old trunk out back. I've unlocked the door for you so go right ahead. It's yours.
I swiped {a_cat} from Spina's private stash. Made it all the way up here before I realized I've got no use for it.
Must be worth something though!
So what do you say? I'll part with {the_cat} for the tiny sum of 300 fruit.
Spina won't notice it missing, there are hundreds of things in the stash.
Yoku, take {a_cat}! And find a bucket and fill it with some <style3>Fresh Spring Water</style3>, from the hot springs over to the right.
Oh, you just scooped up {the_cat} just like that huh?
Well, I'll just head on back to camp. I'll uh, see you there!
Keep {the_cat} you just knocked loose. I'm trying to solve a puzzle, and the clues are <style2>Chunks</style> of a statue.
Tell you what, bring any <style2>Chunks</style> you find over to my house in the Village and I'll let you in on this mystery!
According to my scrying, {a_cat} is nearby!
This button is the first part of the sequence. I'll keep it pressed down while you go searching for {the_cat}! Keep your eyes peeled for its magical gleam below!
Trouble finding {the_cat}? It should be somewhere below! Look for its magical gleam!
Fine work, assistant! We shall wipe the smugness off Umbaba's face yet!
Ahh there it is, {the_cat}. Once again in plain sight and just out of reach.
Excellent! Quickly, let's head back to the tent!
